title: Axe Throwing in Victoria
blurb:
Drop in for an hour, let us introduce you to this great sport and guide you through the basics of throwing an axe and hitting the bullseye! Bring your friends and family, a stranger you met on the bus, a tinder date you want to make a great first impression on… grab an axe and get throwing! 

Axe throwing is an amazing indoor activity in Victoria, no matter the weather outside you can always throw and axe!

It’s a great opportunity to learn a new skill under the guidance of our experienced coaches, or perfect the skills you already have.

Axe Throwing is perfect for a Sunday-Funday, a rainy day, smokey fire day, or a get-out-of-the-cold activity. Bring your friends and family, a stranger you met on the bus, a bumble date…grab an axe and get throwing!
